notes.title: v0.5.1 Update
notes.notes:
Server Maintenance Notice
The Asia, Europe, and North America servers will undergo maintenance at UTC \[08:00], with an expected downtime of 5 minutes.


Optimizations
Battle Interface Improvements: Enhanced the display of combat targets on the right side of the battle screen for clearer and more intuitive information presentation.

Skill Description Adjustments: Refined the text descriptions of certain hero skills to ensure greater accuracy and readability.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the Armored Ancient Tree's skill effect behaved abnormally.

Fixed a bug where Wreckage Instructor's skills remained active after death.

Resolved an issue with unclear color display for the Zerg Priest's skills.

Corrected a bug where Genetic Contamination incorrectly activated in the first round.

Fixed persistent flickering in the Minion Details interface.

Adjusted the layering of the Emote System to prevent obstruction of key UI elements.

Improved the New Player Tutorial experience by disabling unintended scroll wheel inputs and fixing an abnormal critical hit issue with Skeleton Warriors.

Fixed incorrect sorting logic for Deck Costs during battles.



Thank you for your support and feedback! We will continue to optimize the gaming experience. If you encounter any issues, please feel free to contact us through official channels.

Happy gaming!

Shark Studio
